responsibility: Declares the optional SWIG-interface generation hook for the main module. Its single exported routine triggers emission of a SWIG `.i` file when the relevant compiler option is enabled, making this module the front-end boundary for foreign-interface file generation rather than ordinary code emission.
same_name_distinction: This is the definition module for the M2Swig pair: it exposes only the single `GenerateSwigFile` hook used by the compiler front end. Unlike `M2Swig.mod`, it does not collect exported symbols, resolve type dependencies, or emit SWIG interface syntax.
